verdict.rationale: A public pricing page exists and lists plan features such as unlimited recordings and transcription, AI summaries, CRM field sync, coaching scorecards, a custom meeting bot, and SSO & SCIM provisioning, so some feature differentiation is visible without contacting anyone. The pack does not show a free tier explicitly, tier names, prices, or which features belong to which tier. Missing for 10: explicit free plan, per-tier dollar prices, feature-to-tier mapping, evidence that basic use needs no 'talk to sales' step, independent corroboration.
